note: A component, imported by Desktop V2 (Settings) and v2 Onboarding (Add a machine), answering J25. Its title, status line, step labels and platform commands live in the component's data; the template draws only the six strings held here.

elements.name: Reach this machine from the tailnet
elements.where: Settings and onboarding: title, line, the tailnet name in mono, status with a toggle; TURNING IT ON CHANGES and DOMOVOI NEVER TOUCHES lists; the public-certificate warning; the off line; Check again when Tailscale is down
copy: Bring Tailscale up yourself, then check again.
Every certificate is recorded in public logs, so this machine's tailnet name becomes public.
Turning it off deletes those files and restarts the service on 127.0.0.1 only.

blocked.reason: no RPC or desktop adapter turns tailnet serving on or off (a certificate for the tailnet name and a listen address beyond loopback); J25 was drawn as an owner decision

humanRead.note: Title, status, steps and per-platform commands are in the component's data, so the gate cannot hold them; read them against the component.
